description: Source code for a REST API managing Row Level Security (RLS) rules in the Superset project, including endpoints for creating, updating, deleting, and bulk deleting RLS rules.

classes.name: RLSRestApi
classes.description: REST API class for managing Row Level Security rules, providing endpoints for CRUD operations and bulk delete.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Creates a new RLS rule; loads request JSON, validates, and executes creation command.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Updates an existing RLS rule identified by primary key; loads request JSON, validates, and executes update command.

methods.name: bulk_delete
methods.description: Deletes multiple RLS rules in bulk based on provided IDs.
